lock.optimizer: Full Adam inherited including log_std moments; never reset
lock.promotion: Both-parent equal-duration mean retained; sample completion not lower; both JM decrease; JF<=1.01*control; tolerance is development allocation only

reward_only_difference: moment_per_Nms .005 -> .020; inherited mean/critic/Adam/RNG identical at fork; actual closed loops diverge after reward-driven updates
scope: 两个既有成功父、相同 nominal 物理初态的开发证据；动作流变化不代表跨患者或跨初态泛化。
